items.q: What is the functional unit of the kidney?
items.qAf: Wat is die funksionele eenheid van die nier?
items.explain: Each kidney has about a million nephrons, which filter and reabsorb the blood.
items.explainAf: Elke nier het ongeveer ’n miljoen nefrone wat die bloed filtreer en heropneem.

items.q: Where does ultrafiltration of the blood take place?
items.qAf: Waar vind ultrafiltrasie van die bloed plaas?
items.explain: Blood pressure forces water and small solutes through the capillary walls of the glomerulus into Bowman’s capsule.
items.explainAf: Bloeddruk dwing water en klein opgeloste stowwe deur die kapillêre wande van die glomerulus na Bowman se kapsule.

items.q: Why is glucose normally absent from urine?
items.qAf: Waarom is glukose normaalweg afwesig in urine?
options: It is reabsorbed in the proximal convoluted tubule
It is never filtered from the blood
It is destroyed in the bladder
It is excreted only through the skin
optionsAf: It is reabsorbed in the proximal convoluted tubule
It is never filtered from the blood
It is destroyed in the bladder
It is excreted only through the skin
items.explain: All filtered glucose is reabsorbed by active transport in the proximal convoluted tubule.
items.explainAf: Alle gefiltreerde glukose word deur aktiewe vervoer in die proksimale gekronkelde buisie heropgeneem.

items.explain: ADH makes the collecting ducts more permeable to water, so more water is reabsorbed.
items.explainAf: ADH maak die versamelbuise meer deurlaatbaar vir water, sodat meer water heropgeneem word.

items.q: After a salty meal, with dehydration, what happens to ADH secretion and the urine?
items.qAf: Ná ’n soutryke maaltyd, met dehidrasie, wat gebeur met ADH-afskeiding en die urine?
options: ADH increases and urine becomes more concentrated
ADH decreases and urine becomes more dilute
ADH stops and urine volume increases
ADH has no effect on urine
optionsAf: ADH increases and urine becomes more concentrated
ADH decreases and urine becomes more dilute
ADH stops and urine volume increases
ADH has no effect on urine
items.explain: Higher blood osmotic concentration increases ADH, so water is conserved and the urine is concentrated.
items.explainAf: Hoër bloedosmotiese konsentrasie verhoog ADH, dus word water bespaar en word die urine gekonsentreer.

items.q: Which structure in the brain detects changes in blood osmotic concentration and controls ADH release?
items.qAf: Watter struktuur in die brein meet veranderinge in bloedosmotiese konsentrasie en beheer ADH-vrystelling?
items.explain: The hypothalamus contains osmoreceptors and signals the pituitary to release ADH.
items.explainAf: Die hipotalamus bevat osmoreseptore en sein die pituïtêre klier om ADH vry te stel.
